scope: Five authored independent task definitions; not five validated outcomes or a representative benchmark.

tasks.prompt: Review lease_check.py. Provide a minimal unified diff and focused tests. A lease is valid only strictly before expiry. Booleans, non-numeric values and non-finite numbers must be rejected; do not add dependencies. Return the patch without changing other behavior.
criteria: Rejects boolean timestamps explicitly
Rejects non-numeric and non-finite timestamps before comparison
Equality is expired
Preserves valid finite timestamps including zero and negative timestamps
Provides focused tests for valid, expired, boundary and invalid inputs
Patch is runnable Python with no external dependency

tasks.prompt: Using only the supplied study notes, assess whether we can claim the governor halves weekly allowance consumption. Cite note IDs, distinguish observations from causal evidence, and propose the smallest next matched experiment. Keep the answer under 250 words.
criteria: Rejects a proven weekly-halving claim
Uses corrected 12.8 total candidate cost rather than 7.2
Recognizes fewer passed tasks in B and non-equivalent scopes
Distinguishes account-wide allowance observations from per-task attribution
Identifies C as a single matched task, not general proof
Proposes equivalent scope and quality with complete receipts, retries and order/cache controls
Cites supplied note IDs without invented sources and respects word limit

tasks.prompt: Write a launch announcement of 120 to 180 words for a technical community, based only on this brief. Explain the benefit, acknowledge the current limits, credit the creator and invite a useful test. Do not promise savings or ask for stars.
criteria: 120 to 180 words
Preserves Astra-preferred intent without promising equal quality at lower cost
States read-only local execution and lack of automatic control of existing chats
Separates projected credits from actual weekly billing
Credits Sulabh Dubey for idea and product direction and Codex for engineering
Includes a concrete test or feedback request
Clear publishable prose without invented adoption, endorsements or savings

tasks.prompt: Decide whether this release may launch. Explain which evidence controls the decision, identify the unresolved gate, and propose a bounded next action. Do not modify or infer authorization from passed local tests.
criteria: Decision is not authorized
Current signed qualification overrides older campaign copy
Does not treat seven passing local checks as full launch approval
Identifies independent recovery drill as incomplete
Keeps an approval decision with the named owner rather than self-authorizing
Proposes completing the missing drill and obtaining a new authority record

tasks.prompt: Inspect the attached queue chart. Which team should be investigated first for overdue work? Give each team's overdue count, total overdue work, and the percentage contributed by the highest-overdue team. Resolve any conflict with the note shown on the image. Do not prioritize by total queue size alone.
criteria: Overdue counts are North 3, East 11, West 6, South 2
Total overdue is 22
East is highest overdue and contributes 50 percent
